rule_of_this_file: Frozen before any development score of any gate. Changes only by a dated amendment appended to 'amendments', made before the scores it could affect.
owner: bee-san 2026-10-18 06:50Z: do all four workstreams, PRs and issues, merge automatically; earlier: 'we need it to run on a ps vita, so smaller == better'
problem: GRAD and GRAD + refine return no line for 5 of the 66 development empty regions (0.076); #97's s8_c24 detector as a gate cost +0.02-0.03 points for 0.92, but Rubi #209 declined its 8,360 B of worker code and 5,700 B of weights

finder.baseline: GRAD + refine: runtime/vocr_lines.c VOCR_LINES_GRAD, then runtime/vocr_lines_refine.c VOCR_REFINE_DEFAULT (0x1F); the C driver eval/finder_tighten.build, checked against the twins on every case
finder.gate: the gate decides per region; 'no text' -> the finder returns no line (nothing is recognized), 'text' -> GRAD + refine unchanged

gate.learned: an int8 network in #97's VTDT layout (synth/textdet_twin.py); K = the head's first map, textdet_twin.run_net(model, grey)[0] on the region's grey (synth/common.to_gray)

modes.region: score = the k-th largest K code of the region's map (the smallest when fewer cells)
modes.boxes: score = the k-th largest K code over the cells whose s x s block meets a GRAD box (-129 when no cell does)

gate.calibration: per candidate, mode and target: for each k, t = the largest code keeping at least the target share of the cal_dlg cases GRAD + refine returns a line for (the (q+1)-th smallest score, q = floor((1 - target) n)); k = the one whose (k, t) leaves the most cal_empty regions with no line (gate says no or GRAD + refine returns none), the smaller k on a tie
gate.screen: a candidate operating point goes to development only if that cal_empty rate is >= 0.85

rules.blank: Rubi's blank-line check (core/vocr_ocr.c vjo_vocr_ink, twin eval/textgate.rubi_ink_edges): text iff a GRAD + refine line's crop has >= 50 edges per 10,000 pixels; t fixed at 1 (calibrated like the others, it has one score level)
rules.rule8: the longest horizontal run of 8 x 8 blocks with >= 16 edge pixels (|dx| or |dy| >= 24) and contrast >= 48; text iff the run is >= t blocks, t calibrated

report_only.s8_c24_seed4: #97's report candidate (5,700 B): as a presence gate (calibrated like the others) and as #97's own gate (its decode returns no line)

training.recipe: train/textgate_train.py: #97's windows, masks, optimiser and QAT; 24,000 steps, 16 windows of at most 192 x 512, QAT from step 19,200; half real (realplus 0.35, teacher 0.35, owner 0.25, devnative 0.05 of the half) and half clean synthetic; presence targets and loss as the trainer's docstring; the last step is the model
training.real_shards: data/manifests/textdet_shards_v1.json's realplus, teacher, devnative and owner shards, without the calibration split's VNs; #97's synthetic shards are not used
training.synth_shards: data/manifests/textgate_shards_v1.json (eval/textgate_data.py synth: #97's generator, synth3's scene pool without any eval/linefind VN or screenshot, eval's screenshots and v14018)

development.wd: VOCR5's development whole dialogue, as #97 (eval/textdet.wd_units: tv_dlg plus the dn_dlg frames tv_dlg does not hold, base / +4 / +8, pooled; 1,515 cases, 1,161 pooled units, 93 VNs); the baseline units are #97's frozen GRAD + refine units
development.scoring: a case the gate passes keeps its GRAD + refine unit; a case it stops reads nothing (every character a deletion). Intervals: eval/textdet.vn_diff, 10,000 VN-cluster resamples, seed 0
development.empties: eval/linefind's empty regions of vita_dev + psp_dev, a reserved test VN's left out: 66; the rate = the share with no line (the gate says no, or GRAD + refine returns none); reported by whether the screenshot is in synth3's default scene pool (#97's caveat: 54 in, 12 out)
development.report_only: the holdout empties (vita_holdout + psp_holdout, 25); per platform and variant

selection_rule.eligible: a learned gate's C runtime (runtime/vocr_textgate.c) gives the twin's score on every development case and empty region; a rule needs no C to be scored
selection_rule.qualifies: for each of VOCR5-S, -N and -L: gate - refine on wd (points, variants pooled) has a VN-cluster 95% interval whose lower end is <= 0 and a point estimate <= +0.10; on native_vita the same interval's lower end is <= 0; and the development empty rate is >= 0.85
selection_rule.size_order: total bytes = int8 blob bytes + the VitaSDK gcc 15.2 -Os .text bytes of the gate's code for its mode (linked with --gc-sections from the gate's entry points; vita/textgate_size.py), then blob bytes, then region before boxes, then the higher target, then the name
selection_rule.winner: the first qualifying candidate in size order
selection_rule.no_winner: negative verdict; GRAD + refine stays as it is; the protected sets are read once for the candidate with the most development empties returning no line among those meeting the wd conditions (labelled not promoted)

protected.when: once, after the selection record is committed and pushed
protected.tests: vita-test + psp-test whole dialogue (eval's regions, base / +4 / +8; #97's GRAD + refine units for VOCR5-S/N/L, with the gate's decisions on the same regions; attempt record)
protected.clannad: CLANNAD's long run: the gate on each page's ROI; GRAD + refine reads of every reference line (eval/textdet_protected's mapping), dialogue CER with and without the gate; lines returned on the pages the references hold no text for

estimates: console time from the MAC rate of VOCR3-H15 (1,564,992 MACs per CTC frame at 5.0-5.2 ms, 333 MHz assumed) and, where measured, vita/a9_cycles.py; every console figure an estimate

pre_study.note: training-side only (calibration cohorts), before this protocol: block-statistics designs (per 8 x 8 / 16 x 16 block: contrast, mean |dx|, mean |dy|, edge share; tiny CNNs of 0.3-5 K parameters on them, trained densely on #97's real canvases) kept at most 0.47 of cal_empty at 0.998 recall of cal_dlg (stride 8, two 3 x 3 x 16 layers); the edge-run rule's run length separated nothing at that recall. #97's detectors read as presence gates: 0.17-0.81 (s4_c4 to s8_c8, 1,004-1,884 B), 0.80-0.91 (s4_c8n5 to s8_c16, 2,228-3,276 B), 0.95 (s8_c24_seed1). The block-statistics CNNs are therefore not carried into the sweep; the rules are, as the baseline the networks must beat
pre_study.cal_reference: #97's s8_c24_seed4 with its own decode on the calibration cohorts: 14 of 11,103 cal_dlg cases with no line (0.9987 kept), 0.904 of cal_empty with no line (its development figures: 3 of 1,515 cases and 0.92)
